charts.title: MIBI-TOF tri-coupled consensus — animation
charts.srcdoc:
Tri-coupled consensus on real MIBI-TOF tissue

CPM ⊕ vertex ⊕ munk run on a human colon-carcinoma field of view (MIBI-TOF imaging, ~120 cells, 8 cell types)

The three mechanics paradigms (CPM voxel, vertex polygon, center-based disc) + their coupled overlay, simulating one shared cell set seeded at the cells' real imaged positions, sizes and named types (squidpy mibitof; densest 64×64 crop). 12 steps.
